bootstrap.interval: 2.5-97.5 percentile; not a calibrated forecast interval
bootstrap.unit: session where the idle episode started

crossValidationP2.pairedOn: same session id, idle start within 15 s

definitions.censored: automated resume (competing activity), log end, missing successor log; right-censored at the last observed entry
definitions.endedA: session_shutdown reason quit/new/resume/fork with no later session_start of the same session (user ended or left this context); competing event, not proof the task is finished
definitions.idleStartA: agent_settled with child wake sum total == 0 (senpi-task + omo-dag), first of a run of settles with no activity between
definitions.idleStartB: assistant message with stopReason stop (primary) / error / aborted, no outstanding task id at that time
definitions.notReturn: extension input, goal continuation, task completion wake, monitor/terminal/codemode notification, omo-health message, stop-hook or retry continuation
definitions.returnA: user_input with source interactive (typed or rpc input); typed /rollover commands are neutral and scanning continues
definitions.returnB: role=user message that is not a rollover-extension injection
